# fmc_mze_manual_nat_rules (Resource)

Bulk-manages a tenant-scoped set of FTD manual NAT rules within a shared NAT policy. Use `before_auto` and `after_auto` (ordered lists, each item carries a tenant-chosen `key`) to declare rules; the resource POSTs them in list order. `match_on` declares the tenant scope and auto-fills the matching fields onto items that omit them. Cooperative ownership — other tenants' rules in the same section are ignored.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "fmc_mze_manual_nat_rules" "example" {
  ftd_nat_policy_id = fmc_ftd_nat_policy.example.id

  match_on = {
    source_interface_id = fmc_security_zone.tenant_example.id
  }

  before_auto = [
    {
      key                  = "ssh_inbound"
      nat_type             = "STATIC"
      original_source_id   = fmc_host.example_lb.id
      translated_source_id = fmc_host.example_real.id
    },
  ]
}
```
